title: Vola
tagline: Vola is the only on-chain volatility Swap that offers liquidity as a service.
description:
Vola is a decentralized volatility swap platform designed to facilitate liquidity provisions against traders who wish to trade volatility.
This innovative platform aims to offer a secure and transparent environment for managing and executing volatility trades, leveraging blockchain technology for enhanced trust and efficiency.
how_its_made:
We would like to make use of the ERC4626 standard to create a vault for liquidity providers. We will use onchain oracles for computing the volatility values and use it as a basis to settle trades against it. We will have 3 main smart contracts : A Vault, volatility estimator and settlement.
We will make use of the HGO coin as a stablecoin for the collateral and the liquidity provision.
